subject: SummitPay: telemetry preservation and access controls during high-error window
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@summitpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@summitpay.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: sudden spike — need preserved telemetry and controls

Karthik —

We saw a sustained error-rate increase and latency spike across a handful of our production routes starting ~2028-07-18T22:40Z (attached sample). The SRE team is collecting traces but Legal is asking us to request preserved copies of any runtime telemetry, request/response logs, and access records from your side for the affected window while we investigate.

Two asks:
- Please confirm you will preserve (no deletion/rotation) all runtime metrics, request logs, and KV cache metadata for 2028-07-18 22:30Z — 2028-07-19 02:00Z.
- Tell us who will have access to those artifacts, how you’ll provide them, and what redaction/PII-sanitization you apply before transfer.

We need an evidence handoff by EOD for our compliance team — can you confirm next steps and an estimated ETA?

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Director, Site Reliability
SummitPay
[Attachment: slo_error_sample_20280718.txt (TXT), ~45KB]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@summitpay.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden spike — need preserved telemetry and controls

Laura — thanks for the heads up and the sample. We’re treating this as an incident and I’ve put a legal hold on the relevant buckets. Next steps (high level):

1) Preservation: we will snapshot application telemetry, request logs, and access logs for the exact window you listed and mark the objects immutable for 30 days.
2) Access: only a small, approved set of internal staff will access the preserved set (Rishi from Operations, Evelyn from Security, Marissa from Legal, and me). No third-party contractors will be granted access without a formal request.
3) Delivery: we can provide a zipped evidence pack via a shared Drive folder (link + limited-time signed access) or deliver a redacted sample in-line in the email if that helps triage.
4) Redaction/PII: by default we redact upstream user tokens and customer-supplied fields flagged by the PII pipeline; we can provide raw logs under an NDA/DocuSign consent if your security team requires it.

I’m looping in Operations and Security to take ownership of the snapshots and to confirm the exact artifact list and ETA.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales (incident lead)
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SummitPay — preservation request (ACTION)

Team — Laura from SummitPay has requested preserved telemetry and clarity on access/redaction for the high-error window (see original below). Action items:

- Rishi: please create immutable snapshots of runtime metrics, request logs, and access logs for 2028-07-18T22:30Z — 2028-07-19T02:00Z and stage an evidence pack. Note: preserve raw logs in a locked S3 prefix and create a redacted copy for sharing.
- Evelyn: confirm who in Security will be on the access list and run a quick audit on any privileged access during the window.
- Marissa: track legal hold and prepare a DocuSign consent for delivering raw logs if SummitPay requests them.

Please reply with ETA for the evidence pack and a short bulleted description of what will be included. This is time-sensitive; SummitPay asked for EOD.

Thanks,
—Karthik

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SummitPay — preservation request (ACTION)

Karthik — we’ve completed the following:

- Snapshots created and marked immutable: s3://redwood-preserved/summitpay/2028-07-18-22-30_to_2028-07-19-02-00/ (objects locked, 30d retention).
- Evidence pack (redacted) produced: runtime_metrics_20280718.csv, slo_error_sample_20280718.txt, access_log_sample_anon.txt. Attached a small redacted excerpt for immediate triage.
- Raw logs: preserved but stored in a sealed prefix; access requires DocuSign consent + legal approval.
- Audit trail: generated an access log for all internal reads during snapshot creation; Evelyn, please let me know if you want the signed audit export attached.

ETA: I can upload the redacted evidence pack to Drive and share a time-limited link within 60 minutes. If SummitPay requests raw logs we’ll route through the DocuSign flow and Legal review (Marissa).

[Attachment: runtime_metrics_20280718.csv (CSV), 2.1MB]

—Rishi
Director, Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@summitpay.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden spike — telemetry preservation and access controls during high-error window

Laura — quick update and delivery plan: 

1) Redacted evidence pack uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSummitEvidence (time-limited link, read-only). Pack contents: runtime_metrics_20280718.csv, slo_error_sample_20280718.txt, access_log_sample_anon.txt.
2) Raw logs: preserved in sealed S3 prefix. We’ll provide raw data only after we receive a signed DocuSign consent (link below) and a formal request from your legal team.
3) Access control: current internal access list: rishi_malhotra, evelyn_hart, marissa_cole, and me. We’ll produce an audit export of any privileged reads during snapshot creation if you require it.
4) Sanitation: default redaction removes customer-supplied freeform fields and tokens; we can run an additional PII scan on demand and supply a redaction map.

DocuSign consent (if you want raw logs): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=demo&templateId=abcd-1234

If this plan works I’ll have the Drive share changed to include your ops address and send an audit export. ETA for the redacted pack was 60 mins and it’s up now.

Regards,
—Karthik
VP, Sales (incident lead)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: access_log_sample_anon.txt (TXT), ~120KB]

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@summitpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@summitpay.com, Eric Morales <eric.morales@summitpay.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden spike — telemetry preservation and access controls during high-error window

Karthik — thanks for the fast turnaround and the Drive link; our SREs are triaging the redacted pack now. A couple quick follow-ups from Security and Legal: 

- Does the redacted pack include any request payloads that could contain customer PII? If so, please confirm fields removed and provide the redaction map.
- Our legal team also asked for your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or a pointer to where we can pull it) and confirmation that the sealed S3 prefix is not accessible to any external vendors.

We’ll review the artifacts and let you know if we need the raw logs; if we do, we’ll start the DocuSign flow and get back to you.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

—Laura
Director, Site Reliability
SummitPay
